registryAssessment: The Municipio de Hermosillo identifies a municipal Dirección de Catastro and publishes cadastral valuation cartography/services. The indexed products reviewed are valuation maps, not verified parcel geometry.

officialPrimarySources.observation: The Municipio de Hermosillo identifies a municipal Dirección de Catastro and publishes cadastral valuation cartography/services. The indexed products reviewed are valuation maps, not verified parcel geometry.

Official municipal pages establish Catastro and cadastral cartographic products, including 2025 unit-value maps by region. A public-indexed Catastro Digital link leads to a municipal-account sign-in; no credentials were used. PDF map sheets are valuation/cartographic products and were not treated as parcel feature geometry.
